# Project management

`TASK_BOARD.md` lists every task with its gate, owner, reviewer and status, `ROADMAP_STATUS.md` tracks the project's phases against the experiments and research questions, and `RISK_REGISTER.md` lists the open risks with their mitigations and owners. The Research Project Manager maintains all three, with the Academic Supervisor approving changes to the roadmap and each risk owner updating their own rows.
